headings:
A familiar name.
A more poetic presence.

Keep the name.
Give it room to breathe.

A leaf. A page.
A small movement of water.

Odisha at the edges.
The words at the centre.

One family.
Different kinds of page.

Let the poem travel
with its poet.

A usable guide.
A careful final finish.

A different world
on every cover.
Sabita Singh Meera/ सविता सिंह मीरा

Words that find
their way back.

A familiar name.
Room for the poetry.

Find a poem.
Stay a little longer.
